title: Categorize server: undoing an accept with a category picked by search destroys the row's AI suggestions (manual row overwrites rank 1, undo deletes manual rows)
description: From review-mjug-3.md (on budget-mjug), confirmed live; already on main. settleSuggestions (api/src/categorize/decision-store.ts:127-133) upserts a manual rank-1 row over the AI suggestion, and undo deletes manual rows (store.ts:685): after accept-by-search then undo the row comes back 'not classified' with no chips. Keep the AI suggestions intact when the user picks another category (record the manual choice separately, e.g. on categorize_decisions) so undo restores them. Also first noted in review-edxg-2.md F4.
